Rendering.PresentationRetrying.zh: 画面更新未完成，正在重试。画布操作将在恢复后继续可用。
Rendering.PresentationRetrying.en: The canvas update did not complete. Retrying; canvas interaction will resume after recovery.

Rendering.PresentationFailed.zh: 画面更新失败，已暂停画布操作。请切换画布显示后重试。
Rendering.PresentationFailed.en: The canvas update failed; canvas interaction is paused. Toggle canvas visibility to retry.

Rendering.PresentationRecovered.zh: 画面已恢复，画布操作可继续使用。
Rendering.PresentationRecovered.en: The canvas display has recovered. Canvas interaction is available again.

Document.RestoreKindMismatch.zh: 文件的画布类型已改变。请单独打开该文件；当前画布和未保存改动已保留。
Document.RestoreKindMismatch.en: The file's canvas type has changed. Open it separately; the current canvas and unsaved changes have been preserved.
